about: The QA lane's fixed questions for the parts library (P0): 5 new things to test, in QA's own words (fewer than the visual lanes: QA has no verdicts yet; the count is stated in every eval). Written before any method was run on them; labelled blind by two labellers (labels.json). Add a question only from real work, never to suit a method.

questions.brief: test a damage remote: hostile arguments (NaN, huge numbers, wrong types, nil), spam from one player, an exploiter calling it for another player
test saved data: the player leaves mid-save, the data store errors, an old save format loads, values out of range
test a combo's timing: inputs too early and too late, the hit-stop window, the next attack only inside the window
test the shop UI flow: open, buy, not enough coins, close, reopen; no soft lock, every button responds
check a new VFX preset before it ships: the layer budget, no missing textures, the timeline fits the duration
